# Cvixeo

> Cvixeo is an AI CV builder and ATS resume optimizer with job description matching. Users create or import a CV, improve it with AI, compare it with a specific job description to find missing skills and keywords, get a match score, and export a PDF. Available in English, French and Dutch.

## What Cvixeo does

- AI CV builder: generates a professional summary and impact-focused bullet points from the user's experience.
- ATS optimization: checks a CV against Applicant Tracking System criteria (structure, wording, keywords) and suggests improvements.
- Job description matching: compares a CV with a pasted job description and returns a match score broken down by skills, experience, keywords, education and languages, plus matching/missing keywords and recommendations. The analysis can be re-run after editing.
- CV import: PDF, DOCX or TXT, then AI improvement of the content.
- 15 professional CV templates, PDF export.
- AI cover letter generator tailored to a job description and company.

## What the score means

The match score measures textual and structural alignment between a CV and a job description. It is not a hiring probability, not an interview probability and not a guarantee of ATS acceptance. Cvixeo is currently in beta.

## Pricing (EUR)

- Free: 1 CV, 2 templates, watermarked PDF export.
- 7-Day Premium Pass: €3.99 one-time.
- Premium: €12/month, or €9/month billed annually (€108/year). Includes job description matching, cover letters, all templates, unlimited CVs and watermark-free PDFs.
